why: Stops comparing the topbar's chips before and after the flash is shown. A flash placed in the bar row as a flex item would never overlap a chip -- it would push them -- and that is the permanent ammunition counter issue #356 rules out. Chips that move when the flash appears are the only symptom of it.
killedBy: topbar clearance verdict (issue #687) fails a flash that moves the chips when it shows, which is a chip claiming room in the bar
